review_method: Read each linked page, compared its concepts with existing notes and the revised local AQA specification. Retained existing worked examples, tables and diagrams. Additions use original wording and examples.

coverage_decisions.decision: Retained all eight current AQA contexts, including autonomous vehicles absent from the source list. Added cloud-adoption causes and a developed stakeholder example instead of a disconnected list of pros and cons.

Used the source as a discussion-coverage prompt, not legal guidance. Did not import outdated current-law wording, simplistic hacking/cracking definitions, blanket every-essay-three-perspectives rules or detailed copyright-of-algorithms as a required 2027 context.
Expanded retrieval on privacy principles, indirect stakeholders, proportionality, employment, implants and lifecycle trade-offs. Existing qualified privacy and data-protection explanations retained.

checks.browser_review: Passed all topic reading groups and expanded deck at 1366, 390 and 320 pixels. Checked print visibility, hidden sources, focus, keyboard controls, long prose and code answers.
